note: V2 qualification stack. Reuses the V1 policy, attestation log and escrow adapter on this chain; only the three new contracts were deployed.

evaluator.note: The key bound in Concordium CIS-8. Holds EVALUATOR on the attestation log, which is what makes the agent's badge claim true.

committee.note: Must be re-registered every reward period, which is 24 hours. The registry is fail-closed: a period with no committee refuses every certificate.

qualifierRole.note: Holds QUALIFIER_ROLE on ConcordiumQualifier and nothing else. A leaked qualifier key can write qualifications but cannot award, attest or move escrow. Granted 2026-11-11 and revoked from the admin key in the same run, so the compromised admin can no longer record a qualification; it keeps DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and can therefore re-grant if this key is lost.
